positions.name: MissingIdHandlingConstraints
positions.frame: what constraints govern handling a missing-id failure pattern in the derive-id pipeline?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere around the missing-id failure pattern: src-1 identifies and reproduces the production defect (a heading with no id field), while src-2 sets the non-negotiable behavioral constraints for handling it (no crash, valid slug). The shared directional read spans diagnostic identification and prescriptive requirements under one competence-oriented, calm-technical stance.
